description: No defined processes for network security testing.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 11.1 - Processes and mechanisms for regularly testing security of systems and networks are defined and understood
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for the absence of documented security testing processes, procedures, and schedules. Verify that testing processes are defined for all network components and security controls within the cardholder data environment (CDE).
